Name: Immersive Jas
Author: SirPipocado
Description:
[size=5][b]Immersive Characters - Jas[/b][/size]

If you love Shane and always choose to marry him, but wish you could adopt Jas and bring her to live on the farm with you both, this mod is for you. Now you can bring little Jas to the farm, where she'll have a pink room all to herself.

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]

[b]Dialogue[/b]
Jas gets over 80 new lines of dialogue! Check out the topics and special moments that now feature new dialogue:
[list]
[*]Arrival at the farm[/*]
[*]In her new home[/*]
[*]Jas and Shane[/*]
[*]Bonding with the farmer[/*]
[*]Animals and farm chores[/*]
[*]Marnie, Vincent, and Penny[/*]
[*]Weather and seasons[/*]
[/list]
[b]Map Edits[/b]
Jas gets a room all to herself in the farmhouse.
[list]
[*]House Upgrade 1 – her room is located below Shane's spouse room.[/*]
[*]House Upgrade 2 – her room is located above the children's bedroom.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Schedule Changes[/b]
Jas's original schedule and responsibilities have been adjusted to fit her new life. Jas moves into the farmhouse and can roam around the house whenever she has no scheduled activities, or around the farm if the Wandering Spouses mod is installed.

[b]New Events[/b]
This mod adds three new scenes for Jas after she moves to the farm:

[b]A new 8-heart event[/b]
How to trigger: Enter a coop containing at least one adult chicken between 6 AM and 6 PM.
[spoiler]
Jas is standing near an egg on the ground, watching a hen.
The farmer approaches (smiling). Jas picks up an egg.
The hen approaches and clucks. Jas takes a step back.

Player choice:
1 — “I think she wants to meet the new helper.”
Jas: “Oh… Hi. I'm Jas.”
Jas turns toward the hen.
Jas: “I'm going to live here now. In the house, I mean.”

2 — “Let's give her some room to get by.”
Jas takes a step to the side. The hen walks over to the feeder.
Jas: “Oh… She wanted to eat.”
Jas: “That's a relief. I wouldn't have known how to apologize in ‘chicken language.’”[/spoiler]

[b]A new 9-heart event (9 AM – 6 PM)[/b]
How to trigger:
[spoiler]
Enter Marnie's Ranch.
Jas and Marnie are talking about the eggs Jas collected on your farm and decide to make pancakes.

Player choice:
1 — “Sure. I'd love to try those pancakes.”
Jas: “Auntie makes them really thin. I'm going to try to make them just like that.”
Marnie: “Well, come on in, then. We can set an extra plate.”

2 — “I'll let Shane know. Maybe he'd like to come.”
Jas: “He definitely would! Tell him there's jam!”
Marnie: “Tell him to hurry over. Cold pancakes just aren't as good.”[/spoiler]

[b]A new 10-heart event (12 PM – 6 PM)[/b]
How to trigger:
[spoiler]
The player enters the playground. Jas is jumping rope while Shane watches from a short distance away.

Player choice:
1 — “Can I watch the next attempt?”
Jas: “Sure! Stand near him. That way I can see both of you.”
Shane: “Now we've got an audience. No pressure.”
Jas: “Shane!”
Shane: “Alright, alright. I'll stay quiet.”

2 — “Let's count together, Shane.”
Shane: “Sounds good. If I mess up, you've got my back.”
Jas: “But you have to count the same way I do. Otherwise, it gets confusing.”[/spoiler]

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].[/*]
[*]Unzip the mod into your Mods folder. It comes with two folders, Immersive Jas and [CP] Immersive Jas, and both are needed.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
This mod only requires Content Patcher! For additional custom dialogue, especially if you intend to date or marry Shane, aedenthorn's Custom Fixed Dialogue or datamancer's Custom Fixed Dialogue - Continued is optional but recommended.

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
The following mods have built-in compatibility with Immersive Jas:
[list]
[*]Immersive Characters - Shane[/*]
[*]Marry Me - Reverse Wedding Proposals[/*]
[*]Aster's Bathroom Extension[/*]
[*]Wandering Spouses[/*]
[/list]PT-BR translation included.

[b]Potentially Incompatible Mods[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley Expanded: not tested[/*]
[*]Other dialogue mods: not tested[/*]
[*]Other schedule mods: not tested[/*]
[*]Other farmhouse map mods: not tested[/*]
[/list]
Jas's appearance mod used in the screenshots: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24671]Cuter Jas - Seasonal and Festival Outfits[/url]

[size=4][b]Special Thanks & Credits[/b][/size]
A huge thank you to Nitta_Ant for coming up with the original idea for this mod, helping with debugging, creating the thumbnail artwork, and contributing ideas, dialogue, and scenes throughout development. Her creativity and support were essential in bringing this project to life!

[b]Nitta_Ant[/b]: [url=https://www.twitch.tv/niitaant]Twitch[/url] — Original concept, debugging assistance, artwork, ideas, dialogue, and scenes.
[b]SirPipocado[/b]: Programming, coding, and technical implementation.
